title: Reverse Vowels of a String
statement: Given a string s, reverse only the vowels ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u', both upper and lower case) in place among their own positions, leaving all other characters where they are, and return the resulting string.
hints: Converge two pointers from opposite ends of the string, but only act when both point at vowels.
Advance the left pointer past consonants and pull the right pointer back past consonants; only swap when both land on vowels.
while left < right: if chars[left] is not a vowel, left += 1; elif chars[right] is not a vowel, right -= 1; else swap chars[left] and chars[right] and move both pointers inward.
